sections.title: Scope (confirmed)
sections.intro: Order alerts tell a customer when an order ships or is delayed. One event creates at most one alert.

blocks.caption: A repeated webhook hits the unique key; only deliveries change state.
blocks.ascii: Carrier webhook -> alert_events (unique source key) -> alert_deliveries (retry until SENT) -> Customer push

items.title: A repeated event sends a second alert
fields: The carrier webhook can arrive twice and the design has no dedupe key.
The "shipped" webhook for order 1042 arrives at 10:00 and again at 10:02; the customer gets two pushes.

items.title: Push failures are silent
fields: A failed push is logged and forgotten.
The push provider times out during a burst; the alert is marked sent.

items.title: Two tables: events and deliveries
fields: An event never changes; a delivery has a lifecycle.

items.why: One row per alert, edited in place
